title: Civil Inspection Officer
content_text:
Civil Inspection Officer - Shire of Serpentine-Jarrahdale
Armadale, Western Australia Full-time
Posted: 14 days ago Closes: 09 Oct
Civil Inspections Officer
- Full Time Permanent
- One of the Fastest Growing Local Governments in Australia with great Career Opportunities!
- Family Friendly - 9-day Fortnights / Paid Parental Leave!
- 12% Super - Choose to co-contribute and receive up to 18%!
Avoid the city chaos and embrace the family friendly, country town atmosphere of Mundijong! Use your civil maintenance experience to help maintain the Shire's vital infrastructure.
Join us at "The Shire"
Here at "The Shire" we live and breathe our values of Accountability, Collaboration and Trust to proactively support our fellow employees and our local community.
We are seeking an experienced and motivated Civil Inspections Officer to undertake inspections of civil infrastructure assets across the Shire and support the planning and delivery of maintenance programs. This role combines field-based inspections, stakeholder engagement, reporting and data management to ensure our assets remain safe, compliant and well maintained.
In this role you will have the following accountabilities:
- Undertake inspections of roads, drainage, paths and other civil infrastructure assets.
- Identify maintenance requirements and assess asset condition and risk.
- Develop and implement inspection programs in collaboration with operational teams.
- Prepare inspection reports and recommend corrective actions and maintenance priorities.
- Maintain accurate inspection, asset and work order records using digital systems.
- Provide timely advice and support to operational teams and stakeholders.
- Work closely with customers and community members to address enquiries and concerns relating to civil infrastructure.
Our preferred candidate will be able to demonstrate the following experiences and skillset:
- Certificate III in Civil Construction or equivalent relevant experience.
- Experience within civil construction, civil maintenance, utilities or a similar operational environment.
- Experience assessing asset condition and identifying maintenance priorities.
- Strong organisational skills with experience planning and coordinating inspection programs.
- Experience using tablets, asset management systems and work order software
- Ability to work independently in the field while maintaining strong communication with operational teams.
- Sound written communication skills with the ability to prepare clear reports and recommendations.
- Current WA C Class Driver's Licence and Construction White Card.
The Important Stuff!
We will negotiate a great salary with you in the range of $81,745 - $84,216 per annum depending on the experience you bring to the role.
Not only will you have the opportunity to swap the city chaos for our fabulous natural environment and quiet rural outlook, here are some other great benefits:
- Free local gym membership
- If you choose to contribute additional super, we will match up to 3% as a co-contribution
- Wellness programs including Fitness passport
- Free counselling, health assessments and health insurance discounts, annual flu vaccination and skin cancer screening
- Two additional Local Government days off per year
- The option of Purchased Leave
- Salary packaging options, including novated leasing
- Professional development opportunities - study leave and study assistance
- Free Onsite Parking
About the Shire!
With the Operations Depot located in Mundijong just 45 minutes from the Perth CBD on the picturesque backdrop of the Darling Scarp, our Shire is one of the fastest growing Local Governments in Australia.
Our community come from all walks of life and so do we. We hire great people from a wide variety of backgrounds, not just because it's the right thing to do but because it makes our organisation stronger.
Where do I apply?
Applications close on Friday 9th October 2026, but we are reviewing applications as they come in and the position may close earlier than expected. We recommend you apply as soon as possible. We encourage applications from all areas, including Rockingham, Mandurah, Peel and Pinjarra regions.
Note: The Shire will collect personal information from you during the recruitment process, which will only be used or disclosed when required to effectively process your application.
